newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grains slightly in lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grains slightly in lacklustre trade.

text.p: UK cash grain values were around 0.50 to one stg higher on Friday in lacklustre trading.
"We've hardly done a thing all day, thank goodness it's Friday," said one broker.
No trading was reported on the fob market although old crop May was offered at 100 stg with a bid at 99.50 stg and Jun at 101 stg with a buyers at 100 stg.
New crop Sept was offered at 99 stg with no bid while Oct/Dec was a seller at 102.50 stg also with no buyer.
On the delivered market milling wheat 11 percent protein in midlands traded at 114 stg for May.
Feed wheat in East Anglia was trading at 105.50 stg for May and up to 106.75 stg for Jul.
Feed barley on the south coast was fetching 100.50 stg for Apr.
